summary_text: In April 2026, the user purchased aerated drinks on four independent dates (2026-04-08, 2026-04-14, 2026-04-17, 2026-04-29). Sprite was purchased on three of these dates (04-08, 04-14, 04-29), meeting the repetition bar for stable preference. Coca-Cola was purchased on one date (04-17), remaining a single-date observation. Purchases occurred on weekdays across morning, afternoon, and evening dayparts, aligning with population baselines for those times.

stable_preference_claims.claim_text: The user has a stable preference for Sprite, evidenced by purchases on three independent dates in April 2026 (04-08, 04-14, 04-29).

trend_claims.claim_text: Coca-Cola was purchased on a single date (2026-04-17) in the afternoon. This is an isolated observation and does not indicate a stable preference.

uncertainty_text: While Sprite shows a stable pattern across three dates, the user also purchased Coca-Cola once. The overall brand preference is not exclusive to Sprite, but Sprite is the only brand with sufficient repetition to claim stability. Single-date observations (Coca-Cola) are excluded from stable lists.
